items.title: Exxon Earnings, Chevron Earnings Face Steep Expectations: A Triple-Digit Profit Spurt
items.summary: Exxon earnings and Chevron earnings are on deck early Friday, and Wall Street expects a massive profit spurt.  As usual, both Exxon Mobil and Chevron provided key updates ahead of their reports.  For Q2, analysts expect Exxon Mobil earnings per share to more than double to $3.56, FactSet shows.
